title: Draft: retimed T488 composition targeting conditional kappa 0.00173041889976
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Draft composition of PR #3642's retimed suppliers with PR #3633's literal T488 allocation. Candidate conditional κ = **0.001730418899766071163804 − 10^-46 − 10^-70**, a prospective absolute improvement of **0.000000024507952107748684** over pinned PR #3642. **Full admission is still running; this is not yet an admitted improvement.**

The complete paid profile is `{1:10817496,2:3179808,3:1024434,4:447984,5:94794,8:35136,48:186782}` across 4,392 calls and 1,791,936 helper roles; 437,248 live and 437,757 physical families, including 91 private zero buffers.

All inherited all-size dispatch/compiler, recursive rounding, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, SCALAR/COPY/CLEAR/zero-allocation, uniform coefficient/stock, bootstrap, precision/tape/recovery and analytic/BIT H1–H5 assumptions remain. No unconditional theorem, formal-kernel proof, independent human review or selected-frontier update is claimed.

## Task and overlap

User-directed work, retrospectively classified under `scalar-to-moment`, refined scope. Base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; exact dependencies PR #3642 `abc12f62e4fe9bfcb2e33c84703253c918668351` and PR #3633 `72c268f113368ea0387d188225e3f81ba6d6ef73`. This composes existing local and allocation advances; neither is claimed as newly discovered here. PR #3642 has since advanced to `80c0f2906d4ecd66325c42fcf3cfd5070a088bdb`; this draft retains its explicit original pin.
